rule: These are manufactured symbolic gate expectations. Actual parent-bound substitutions require the same or stricter gates plus the module recipe. A missing required token is a hard stop.

A-WL-001.decision: PASS only when lane increment is exactly 2 n and normalized weights sum to one.

A-WL-002.decision: PASS only when all three roles are independent and the directed carrier is complete, unique, and non-self.

B-WL-001.decision: Require the carrier mode to be preserved and every nontrivial operator eigenvalue to lie strictly between zero and one.

B-WL-002.decision: Require conserved mean, strict nontrivial compression, and reopening residual within the frozen tolerance.

C-WL-001.decision: Reject non-Hermitian candidates; compare exact invariants with the independently reconstructed matrix.

C-WL-002.decision: Substitute only source-derived symmetry generators. Empty, inconsistent, or empirically selected solution families are BLOCKED.

D-WL-001.decision: Require exact conserved total and nonpositive Lyapunov derivative in the frozen domain.

D-WL-002.decision: Require one conserved mode and internally justified decaying/stiff modes.

E-WL-001.decision: Require every declared stoichiometric invariant to lie in the exact left nullspace.

E-WL-002.decision: Require the conservation check to reduce exactly to zero and classify stiffness before numerical execution.

F-WL-002.decision: Require symmetric PSD covariance after the exact frozen transfer.

G-WL-001.decision: Require positive opacity and visibility normalization at the declared boundary.

G-WL-002.decision: Require exact particle-number and charge bookkeeping for the frozen recombination reactions.

HU-WL-001.decision: Require exact linearity and semigroup composition before the operator is frozen.

HU-WL-002.decision: Require the declared constraint functional to be an exact left zero mode.

I-WL-001.decision: Require exact kinematic identities from the internally derived scale/background state.

I-WL-002.decision: Require the background constraint derivative to vanish on the frozen equations.

HI-WL-001.decision: Require exact immutable composition of the H operator with the I background.

HI-WL-002.decision: Require symmetric PSD propagated covariance; symmetry alone is not sufficient.

J-WL-001.decision: Require positive-definite covariance and exact Cholesky reconstruction.

J-WL-002.decision: Finite-volume implementation must enforce exact conjugate pairing and preserve the frozen seed.

K-WL-001.decision: Require exact pairwise antisymmetry and then verify total momentum in the numerical execution.

K-WL-002.decision: Require unit Jacobian determinant for the manufactured leapfrog map and convergence in the actual system.

L-WL-002.decision: Require an internally generated normalized stellar birth measure; importing an IMF is forbidden.

M-WL-001.decision: Require exact isotope/nucleon bookkeeping for every admitted reaction.

M-WL-002.decision: Substitute only frozen internally derived cooling/opacity laws and classify signs, singularities, and covariance.

KLM-WL-001.decision: Classify every frozen branch by its actual spectrum; do not force attraction or uniqueness.

KLM-WL-002.decision: Preserve finite-cycle and divergent countermodels so fixed-point narrative cannot override the recurrence.

N-WL-001.decision: Require every truth product to trace to the triad through one compatible causal graph.

N-WL-002.decision: Substitute the frozen cross-covariance and require PSD; setting cross-blocks to zero needs a derivation.

O-WL-001.decision: Require content-addressed identity to change under any material mutation.

O-WL-002.decision: Require isolated sibling branches O->P and O->Q with no P backflow.

P-WL-001.decision: Require frozen predictions to be algebraically independent of loaded comparison data.

P-WL-002.decision: Freeze covariance admissibility before public values are loaded.

Q-WL-001.decision: Classify terminal branches from the frozen derivative; do not assume attraction.

Q-WL-002.decision: Qualified memory may condition but may not impersonate the next CIF source.
